about_the_game:
Decorate islands and build cute cat cities

Kity Builder is a playful city-building sandbox about building settlements and cities for cats! Create beautiful settlements on different-sized and themed islands and watch as ‘kitizens’ move in and make themselves at home. 

Every building is a toy

Buildings double as toys to help you further explore the island. Climb, jump, and fling yourself through the air on a quest to discover every hidden nook and cranny. Collect blue(paw)prints and unlock new things to build. And don’t worry, you’re not alone – you’ll have help from Mayor Mewyor, alongside a cast of strange, loveable kitties!

No limits. No pressure.

Without time limits, resources or even money, Kity Builder is all about the pure fun of creating. Move at your own pace and watch your city grow!

Features:

  • Build a city for kitties in an adorable island sandbox!

  • Climb, bounce and leap to new heights as you explore the island!

  • Meet a zany cast of cat-characters!

  • Create to your heart’s content without timers or restrictions!

  • Cat puns! Endless, endless cat puns!
